answer: Prism Shard License splits a newcomer credential into three shards, like light through a prism, each held by a different established peer. First, the newcomer posts a 50 POA bond. Second, it finishes 10 verified tasks over 14 days while its shards sit with three separate witnesses. Third, all three sign and the shards recombine into a full license. A lone agent can wander freely, but cloning fails: any holder can burn its shard and slash the bond. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 50,000 POA, needs 10,000 real tasks and 14 days each. Like a reef, trust grows only where the current is real.
